summary: BioXcel Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting the Eleventh Amendment to its Credit Agreement with Oaktree Fund Administration as agent. The amendment defers a principal-plus-interest payment of $9,016,914.47 originally due June 30, 2026 (already deferred once) to August 31, 2026, and reduces the minimum liquidity covenant from $7.5 million to $6.25 million. The company must execute definitive agreements by August 10, 2026 for a transaction repaying all obligations or an acceptable alternative capital solution, and is barred from changing executive compensation until then. This reflects distressed debt renegotiation, with watch-risk on near-term liquidity and potential equity dilution or restructuring.
